verdict_reason: New tests cover addAddressAnswers, addressBookListPath and the start link with exact assertions; one Major test-readability finding on a title that claims more than its assertion proves.

todos.issue: Title 'the %s request is tagged with %s, an endpoint in the catalogue' claims a request is tagged with the endpoint, but the 'tagged with' half is the map entry the test reads its own inputs from (test.each over ADDRESS_BOOK_SESSION_ENDPOINTS), so no line of front-door.js can turn it red. The assertion only proves the endpoint name is in ENDPOINTS.
todos.fix: Must: the title states only what the assertion proves. One way: 'the %s request's endpoint %s is in the endpoint catalogue'.
